selection: All 4 strict Evidence F1 wins, plus 6 known ties selected for category variety: hierarchy_07, expand_null_01, expand_direct_03, expand_indirect_03, expand_moderation_02 and expand_null_03. Selection made after observing outcomes, without further optimization of aggregate scores. Ordered by F1 gain then question ID.

questions.question: What moderators have been tested for the relationship between self-handicapping and academic performance?
questions.interpretation: Clear retrieval gain: combined retrieval includes sh_108 and correctly reports gender moderation; Hybrid Text RAG misses that study and cannot answer the requested relationship.

questions.question: What findings distinguish positive/adaptive from negative/maladaptive perfectionism in their relationships with self-handicapping, including tested null results?
questions.interpretation: Finding-list coverage gain with equal article recall: combined answer includes the sh_143 maladaptive-perfectionism prediction. Hybrid Text RAG places that detail only in limitations, outside the scored claim list. Utility is tied.

questions.question: Through which processes does academic psychological capital relate to academic achievement, and are the reported pathways parallel or sequential?
questions.interpretation: Precision gain with identical reference-path recovery and article recall: both recover two parallel routes, but the combined method produces one fewer out-of-scope finding. Utility is tied; this is not better path discovery.

questions.question: What empirical findings link fear of failure with self-handicapping?
questions.interpretation: Small retrieval and finding-recall gain: combined retrieval adds sh_193 and one matched finding, plus one additional out-of-scope finding. Utility is tied.

questions.question: What empirical relationships have been reported between procrastination and self-handicapping?
